title: The Scholarship of the water tower
premise: Noor Nakamura, a quiet coder at Meridian High, runs an anonymous account that exposes the school's rot—including the scholarship fund quietly funneled to the children of donors. When his teacher pairs him with Priya Raghavan, the student council president whose family benefits from that fund, for a semester project on 'institutional trust,' their uneasy alliance becomes a real friendship built on Noor's secret. As the account's clues point closer and closer to him, Noor must decide whether to protect his found circle of misfits or tell the truth about who he is, knowing it will cost him Priya's trust. In the end, he confesses publicly at the water tower where they all meet; Priya, betrayed but changed, chooses to co-author the final exposé with him rather than against him.
about_author: Juniper Blackwood grew up in a rust-belt town where the water tower was the tallest thing for miles, and she never stopped writing about kids who watch too closely. She teaches creative writing by day and maintains a suspiciously well-informed anonymous blog by night.

chapters.title: Fine
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. We meet Noor mid-panic as his anonymous account @towerwatch posts its most viral thread yet about the school's leaking roof funds. He insists—to himself, to us—that everything is fine. Emotional beat: anxious denial masked as control.

chapters.title: The Pairing
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Mr. Okafor announces semester partners for the civics capstone: Noor Nakamura and Priya Raghavan. The class snickers; Priya looks like she swallowed glass. Emotional beat: dread, the feeling of a trap closing.

chapters.title: Terms of Engagement
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya drafts a cold contract—split the work, no personal questions—and Noor signs without argument. She's rattled by how easily he agrees. Emotional beat: guarded hostility hiding exhaustion.

chapters.title: The Water Tower Kids
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. After school, Noor climbs to the water tower where his found family gathers: Dex the dropout artist, Marisol the fact-checker, Theo the anxious archivist. They are @towerwatch's unpaid research team. Emotional beat: warmth, belonging.

chapters.title: Institutional Trust
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Researching the capstone topic, Priya reads @towerwatch's archive and feels personally attacked—the account named her father's company in the scholarship scandal. She decides to find out who's behind it. Emotional beat: wounded pride curdling into obsession.

chapters.title: Fieldwork
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Forced together at the county records office, Noor and Priya accidentally work well together, finishing in an hour what should take four. Both pretend not to notice. Emotional beat: reluctant respect.

chapters.title: Marisol's Rule
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. The tower crew debates whether to investigate Priya directly; Marisol forbids targeting individuals. Noor already pulled her father's donation records anyway. Emotional beat: guilt he refuses to name.

chapters.title: The Leak
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. A screenshot of @towerwatch's draft post on the scholarship fund lands in Priya's inbox before publication—someone inside the group is feeding her. She suspects Dex. Emotional beat: paranoia, the thrill of having a weapon.

chapters.title: Study Session
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Priya comes over to work and meets Noor's grandmother; something softens between them over burnt rice and stories of Noor's late mother. Emotional beat: intimacy sneaking past defenses.

chapters.title: Convergence
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Cross-referencing posting times with the school schedule, Priya narrows the suspect list to three students. Noor is one. She tells herself she wants the truth, not revenge. Emotional beat: self-deception.

chapters.title: Homecoming
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. At homecoming, the tower crew drags Noor out of his shell; Priya sees him laughing and realizes she likes him, which makes her investigation feel like betrayal. Emotional beat: longing tangled with suspicion.

chapters.title: The Midterm Post
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. @towerwatch publishes the full scholarship exposé; the school erupts, Priya's father is named, and Priya goes pale in third period while Noor watches, unable to move. Emotional beat: triumph curdling into horror.

chapters.title: Interrogation
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya confronts Noor with the timeline evidence. He lies badly. She lets him leave, then sits alone with the proof she didn't want. Emotional beat: the sick weight of being right.

chapters.title: Fracture
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Noor confesses to the tower crew that he used Priya's family data; Marisol walks out, Theo begs him to come clean, Dex says nothing. Emotional beat: the found family cracking under his choices.

chapters.title: Deadline
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Principal Voss privately offers Priya a deal: help identify @towerwatch and her father's name stays out of the board report. She has one week. Emotional beat: temptation dressed as mercy.

chapters.title: What Dex Knew
chapters.summary: Dex's POV (first shift). Dex reveals he leaked the draft—not to hurt Noor, but because he thought exposure would force Noor to stop carrying everything alone. Emotional beat: love expressed as betrayal.

chapters.title: The Capstone
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Noor and Priya present their project on institutional trust without mentioning either of them is its case study; afterward, Priya gives him until Friday to tell the truth himself. Emotional beat: a countdown disguised as kindness.

chapters.title: Voss Moves First
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. The administration suspends Dex, claiming he's @towerwatch, and announces an assembly to 'address misinformation.' Noor has two days to decide whether letting Dex burn saves everyone else. Emotional beat: cowardice vs. courage.

chapters.title: Confession at the Tower
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Climax. At the assembly, Noor stands up, names himself as @towerwatch, and reads the scholarship findings aloud from the stage. Priya watches, phone in hand, deciding. Emotional beat: terror transfigured into release.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Fallout: Voss resigns under board pressure, the fund is frozen pending audit, and Priya's father, exposed, finally tells her the truth about his donations. She doesn't forgive Noor yet—but she shows up at the tower. Emotional beat: grief beginning to loosen.

chapters.title: Co-Authors
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Priya proposes they write the follow-up together—her access, his sources, both names on it. The tower crew reforms with new rules. Emotional beat: repair without erasure.

chapters.title: The Scholarship of the Water Tower
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. Epilogue. Months later, the renamed Nakamura-Raghavan Civic Fund awards its first need-based scholarship; Noor posts one last time under his own name. Everything is fine. Actually fine. Emotional beat: earned peace.
